messages.text: My rear wheel wobbles. What should I check first?

display_segments.text: My rear wheel wobbles. What should I check first?

messages.text:
Check the spoke tension first.
Spin the wheel and watch the gap at the brake pads.

display_segments.text:
Check the spoke tension first.
Spin the wheel and watch the gap at the brake pads.

messages.text: The gap changes near the valve.

display_segments.text: The gap changes near the valve.

messages.text:
Tighten the two spokes opposite the wobble by a quarter turn:

```sh
spoke-key --turn 0.25 --spokes 7,9
```

messages.text: Good. Check it again after the first ride.
